questions.q: In which part of the digestive system does the maximum absorption of nutrients occur?
questions.qPa: ਪਾਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਦੇ ਕਿਸ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੌਸ਼ਟਿਕ ਤੱਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਮਾਈ (absorption) ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The small intestine is highly adapted for absorbing nutrients into the bloodstream.

questions.q: Which organ produces bile, a fluid that helps in the digestion of fats?
questions.qPa: ਕਿਹੜਾ ਅੰਗ ਪਿੱਤ (Bile) ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਰਬੀ ਨੂੰ ਹਜ਼ਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The liver produces bile, which is then sent to the gallbladder for storage.

questions.q: What is the primary function of the large intestine?
questions.explanation: The large intestine mainly absorbs water from the remaining indigestible food matter.

questions.q: Where is bile stored before it is released into the small intestine?
questions.explanation: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile produced by the liver.

questions.q: What is the basic structural and functional filtering unit of the kidney?
questions.qPa: ਗੁਰਦੇ ਦੀ ਮੁੱਢਲੀ ਢਾਂਚਾਗਤ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਜਸ਼ੀਲ ਫਿਲਟਰਿੰਗ ਇਕਾਈ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The nephron is the microscopic unit in the kidney that filters blood.

questions.q: The primary function of the human kidneys is to:
questions.explanation: Kidneys filter waste products and excess water from the blood to form urine.

questions.q: Which enzyme, found in saliva, begins the chemical digestion of carbohydrates in the mouth?
questions.explanation: Salivary amylase breaks down starches into simpler sugars.

questions.q: Besides the kidneys, which other organ plays a significant role in excreting waste (water and salts) from the body?
questions.explanation: The skin excretes water, salts, and small amounts of urea through sweat.
